units.source_text: 我也不打算一直畫那些不入流的漫畫，今後，把酒戒掉，

en.t: I do not plan to keep drawing those third-rate cartoons forever; from now on, I will give up drinking,

units.source_text: 養好身體，努力用功，當一名偉大的畫家。

en.t: get my body well, study hard, and become a great painter.

units.source_text: 眼下正是關鍵時期，所以拜託你了。

en.t: This is the crucial moment, so I am begging you.

units.source_text: 我親你一下吧。」老闆娘笑了起來。

en.t: Shall I give you a kiss?" The proprietress laughed.

units.source_text: 「真拿你沒辦法，你上癮了，我可管不了呀。」

en.t: "You really are hopeless. If you get addicted, I cannot be responsible for you."

units.source_text: 她噠噠噠地拄著柺杖，從藥架上取下藥。

en.t: Tapping along with her crutch, she took the medicine down from the shelf.

units.source_text: 說：「不能給你一整盒，你馬上就會用完，只給你一半。」

en.t: She said, "I cannot give you a whole box. You would use it up at once, so you get only half."

units.source_text: 「真小氣啊，好吧，也沒辦法。」回家後，我立刻打了一針。

en.t: "How stingy. Well, I suppose it cannot be helped." After I got home, I immediately gave myself an injection.

units.source_text: 「不疼嗎？」良子擔驚受怕地問道。
「當然疼啦。可是，為了提高工作效率，就算不願意也只能這麼做啊。

en.t: "Of course it hurts. But to make my work more efficient, I have no choice but to do this, whether I like it or not.
